messages.author: 1e47949cab368623
messages.subject: ggtern broken under Shiny
parts:
I use ggtern (an extension of ggplot2) to make ternary graphs.  They used to work fine in Shiny (either RStudio or Shiny.io).  However, recently, when I run them in Shiny, they come out differently and with multiple problems.

For example, in the first image below (from R), the axes are labelled, and there are gridlines within the triangle.

In the second image (exact same code in Shiny), only one axis is labelled, the label for another axis has moved to the left of the legend, the arrows are unlabled, and there are no gridlines.

(The code for this graph is available at: http://www.ggtern.com/2013/12/12/feldspar/).

Some things that seem broken in ggtern under Shiny:
  • themes
  • stat_density2d
  • axis labeling
Is anyone else having this issue?  Did something change in Shiny recently that would cause this?  

Thank you,
CB

Fig 2. Feldspar Data in Shiny

messages.author: 1e47949cab368623
messages.subject: Re: ggtern broken under Shiny
parts: By recreating my workspace from May, I've isolated the problem to an update that happened between shiny v 11.1 and 12.1.  As long as I keep shiny at v11.1, everything works as expected.
